patch_description: Replace the homogeneous CRZ entanglement layer with a diverse mix of parametrized two-qubit gates (CRX, CRY, CRZ) and add a final RY output layer. This approach is inspired by Program 2, which achieved the best test accuracy (0.65) and smallest generalization gap (0.04). The mixed gate types provide better expressivity and regularization than uniform CRZ gates. Remove the mid-circuit RZ corrections that degraded performance in the current program. This change balances parameter efficiency with improved generalization.
